verdict.rationale: Railway's evidence covers deployment, CI/CD, cloud agents with persistent disks, and AI integrations, but nothing addresses hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes for running untrusted code — in fact cloud agents are described as persistent ('machine stays running when you disconnect'), the opposite of disposable isolation. Missing for 10: any mention of sandbox isolation technology (VM/hypervisor-level), disposability guarantees, or untrusted-code execution security model.
